data.policy: FineWeb development and separate Wikipedia evaluation; no claim of unseen teacher data
data.revision_policy: Resolve repository revisions to immutable commits before collecting text
data.sampling_policy: Seeded sampling across shards and document lengths; retain whole documents
data.deduplication_policy: Group exact and near duplicates before document-level splitting
data.heldout_policy: Do not inspect test labels or tune on test metrics; any redesign needs a new heldout run

gates.bpb_gate: Upper endpoint of paired document bootstrap 95% CI for candidate minus teacher must be <= 0.01
gates.speed_gate: Teacher/candidate median wall-clock ratio; also report p95 and uncertainty
gates.document_batch_patcher_speed: Report separately; do not substitute for the incremental gate
gates.downstream_quality: Heldout next-byte BPB for this pilot; no claim of task or free-generation quality improvement

budgets.on_budget_exceeded: Stop and report; do not silently alter model or data semantics
budgets.on_no_passing_candidate: Report failed gates before authorizing another search budget

baseline.checkpoint_status: Located; verify conversion hashes and strict loading during T01
